channel.title: Vanta news
channel.description: Release posts for Vanta, a free Minecraft Java launcher for Windows and macOS.

item.title: Vanta 1.6.1: server favourites, a logs viewer and shader previews
item.description: Star your favourite servers, search the game log, flip through screenshots full size, and see shader and resource pack previews before you install.

item.title: Vanta 1.6.0: a home dashboard, modpacks and world backups
item.description: PLAY opens with a dashboard, Modrinth modpacks install in one click with every file hash-checked, and worlds get one-click backups. Plus a crash helper, appearance settings and a native Mac window.

item.title: Vanta for Mac now opens in its own window
item.description: Vanta 1.5.2 for macOS runs in a native Mac window with normal menus and shortcuts, and never opens your web browser.
